changelog: Shotgun. (1) Medaka polishing of Nanopore MAG contigs is now on by default — measured on nextapp: 2 minutes, 4 GB of RAM, 169 of 170 Zymo contigs polished; B. subtilis 55 → 68 % and P. aeruginosa 30 → 54 % complete. (2) MAG split: contigs Kraken 2 cannot name to a genus can now also be left out of both parts; CheckM2 picks whichever placement scores better (for the Zymo Salmonella / E. coli bin that left 20 % contamination). (3) Resistome likely host: the share is now of every classified read carrying the gene, and the report says 'mixed' when fewer than 60 % agree — mobile genes no longer show a confident '100 %' from the few reads Kraken 2 could name. (4) Genes the AMRFinderPlus catalogue marks not reportable are left out. Backend restart required.

previous.changelog: Shotgun: the chart editor showed only read tracking, because the chart tables (r_tables/: taxonomy per rank, heatmaps, alpha diversity, rarefaction…) were never built for shotgun runs — viz_pipeline.R ran after DADA2, ITS, COX1 and PacBio only (Emu runs it itself). Shotgun results are in Emu's layout, which the script already reads; it now runs after every shotgun run. Checked on a real run on nextapp before release. Older shotgun runs: re-analyse, or run viz_pipeline.R on the folder once. Backend restart required.
